_comment: clifford_jets.py の selftest の歯を、 engine の要所を 1 つずつ壊した mutant で確かめる spec (claude-config の check-foil-teeth.py で回す)。 Dirac 作用素の二乗 (Lichnerowicz) と曲率の交換子で engine を押さえていることの確認。

mutants.name: O(eps^2) を落とさない
pairs: d = {m: c for m, c in p.terms() if m[self.ieps] < 2}
d = {m: c for m, c in p.terms() if m[self.ieps] < 3}
expect_pass: the 16 monomials close with real signs

mutants.name: Clifford の積が符号表を使わない
pairs: out[S ^ T] = out[S ^ T] + self.sign[S][T] * A[S] * B[T]
out[S ^ T] = out[S ^ T] + A[S] * B[T]
expect_pass: the sign table read off the matrices is the anticommutation count

mutants.name: closes() が常に真
pairs: return all(s in (1, -1) for row in self.sign for s in row)
expect_fail: matrices that are not a Clifford set are refused
expect_pass: the 16 monomials close with real signs

mutants.name: 正規座標の vierbein の符号
expect_fail: normal-coordinate vierbein: Riemann of the derived metric

mutants.name: spin 接続の W の符号
expect_pass: normal-coordinate vierbein: Riemann of the derived metric

mutants.name: 第 1 Bianchi を見ない
expect_fail: a tensor that breaks the first Bianchi identity is not algebraic
expect_pass: ... and the normal-coordinate vierbein does not reproduce it

mutants.name: 入力の曲率と導いた Riemann を比べない
expect_fail: ... and the normal-coordinate vierbein does not reproduce it
expect_pass: a tensor that breaks the first Bianchi identity is not algebraic

mutants.name: second の 1 階の交差項を 1 つ落とす
Laplacian の 1 階の係数から Christoffel の trace を落とす
Laplacian の 0 階の係数から Gamma Ohat を落とす
expect_fail: laplacian: the coefficients formed once per background

mutants.name: 接続の積から X W を落とす
exact_div が割り切れを確かめない
pairs: assert r == 0, f"coefficient {c} not divisible by {k}"
expect_fail: exact_div refuses a division that does not close
expect_pass: the 16 monomials close with real signs
